# Critique — Twenty Improvements to the Improvement

1. Fewer borders matters more than brighter borders.
2. Prompt must remain the dominant surface.
3. Mode must stay visible in the first mobile viewport.
4. Optional intelligence must remain collapsed.
5. Generate readiness must remain obvious.
6. Avoid making inactive controls too low-contrast.
7. Do not add animations to every component.
8. Reuse one ambient motion language across surfaces.
9. Keep motion compositor-friendly.
10. Preserve reduced-motion behavior.
11. Preserve textarea node identity and focus.
12. Preserve template click behavior.
13. Preserve reference-mode discoverability.
14. Preserve settings/API-key guidance.
15. Preserve bottom-nav thumb reach.
16. Keep all new source files under 120 lines.
17. Do not create CSS specificity wars.
18. Measure actual computed styles after change.
19. Verify public production after exact-SHA deploy.
20. Stop adding style only when the screen is calmer and more legible, not merely richer.
